_comment: Applied to every Math GRPO run on top of the model catalog (command-line args like lr= still win). Restores the RL tuning shared by the pre-restructure configs -- optimizer betas (0.9, 0.95), mb_spec.max_tokens_per_mb packing, and ZeRO reduce_scatter -- which the catalog's SFT-tuned training files do not carry. The "_comment" key is ignored and never reaches the job body.
